title: Novato solo crash critically injures 2 teens, driver arrested - NewsBreak
text: ( KRON ) — A 14-year-old girl and a 15-year-old boy were seriously injured in a solo-vehicle crash early Wednesday morning in Novato, police said. The Novato Police Department responded around 3 a.m. to Ignacio Boulevard between Palmer Drive and Entrada Drive on the report of a car crash. Arriving officers found the two teenage passengers in a white Ford Edge that was heavily damaged. The driver, 18-year-old San Rafael man Cristofer Larreinaga Corea, was arrested for violations of child endangerment and hit-and-run causing injuries, NPD said. Corea, traveling in a vehicle, was later arrested near Nave Drive and Bolling Drive. He suffered injuries in the crash and was taken to the hospital. After being discharged from the hospital, Corea is set to be booked at the Marin County Jail. His bail is currently set at $100,000. The 14-year-old girl is being treated for critical injuries at a regional trauma center, while the 15-year-old boy is at a local hospital in stable condition after sustaining significant injuries, Novato PD said in an update just after 11 a.m. Investigators believe the Ford was traveling west on Ignacio when the driver lost control and struck a tree in the center median. It is unknown if intoxication was a factor in the collision. Anyone who witnessed the collision or has information is asked to call investigators at 415-897-4361. For the latest news, weather, sports, and streaming video, head to KRON4.
